description: Fetch recent videos by one TikTok account: video_description, create_time, duration, cover_image_url, view_count, like_count, comment_count, share_count, favorites_count, hashtag_names and the sound. Give exactly one of `username` or `url`. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

limit.description: At most this many results, 1–30. A page can hold fewer while `next_cursor` is set: read until it is null.

username.description: The username. A leading @ is fine.

name: get_tiktok_videos
title: Get recent videos from a TikTok profile
